title: Shipping & Returns
desc: Delivery times, free shipping over €75 and 30-day returns at Éclat By Sev.
intro: Every Éclat By Sev piece is prepared with care. We currently ship within the Netherlands and aim to make the delivery and returns process as smooth and transparent as possible.
inner:
Processing Time

Most orders are processed and prepared within 3–5 business days. During launches, holidays, or high-demand periods, processing may take slightly longer. If that happens, we will always do our best to keep you informed.

Shipping

We currently ship within the Netherlands only.

  • Free standard shipping on orders over €75
  • Orders below this threshold may be subject to a shipping fee at checkout
  • Once your order has shipped, you will receive a confirmation email with tracking details, where available

Please note that delivery times are estimates and may vary depending on the carrier and location.

Returns

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. To be eligible for a return, your item must be:

  • Unworn
  • Unused
  • In its original packaging
  • Returned in resellable condition

To request a return, please contact us at info@eclatbysev.com with your order number and reason for return.

Refunds

Once your return has been received and inspected, we will notify you of the outcome. If approved, your refund will be processed to your original payment method.

Please allow 5–10 business days for the refund to appear, depending on your payment provider.

Damaged or Incorrect Items

If your order arrives damaged, faulty, or incorrect, please contact us as soon as possible at info@eclatbysev.com.

To help us resolve the issue quickly, please include:

  • Your order number
  • A short description of the issue
  • Clear photos of the item and packaging

We will review the issue and work with you on an appropriate solution as quickly as possible.

Need Help?

For any questions about shipping, returns, or your order, please contact us at info@eclatbysev.com.

title: Privacy Policy
desc: How Éclat By Sev collects, uses and protects your personal information.
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Éclat By Sev collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you visit our website, place an order, or contact us.
inner:
Who We Are

Éclat By Sev is an online jewellery brand. If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, you can contact us at info@eclatbysev.com.

Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of personal information:

  • Your name
  • Your email address
  • Billing and shipping details
  • Order and transaction information
  • Communications you send to us
  • Information you provide when joining our newsletter

We may also collect limited technical information such as browser type, device information, and general website usage data.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Process and fulfil orders
  • Provide customer support
  • Communicate with you about your order
  • Respond to enquiries
  • Improve our website and services
  • Send marketing emails if you have subscribed to our newsletter

Payments

Payments are processed through third-party payment providers. We do not store your full payment card details ourselves.

Marketing Emails

If you subscribe to our newsletter, we may send you updates about new collections, product launches, and brand news. You can unsubscribe at any time by using the unsubscribe link in our emails or by contacting us directly.

Cookies and Analytics

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to improve site functionality, understand visitor behaviour, and enhance the user experience. You can usually manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

Sharing of Information

We may share your information with trusted third parties where necessary to operate our business, such as:

  • Payment providers
  • Shipping partners
  • Website and email service providers

We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

Data Retention

We keep personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfil orders, provide support, comply with legal obligations, and manage our business.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Access your personal data
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your data
  • Object to certain processing
  • Withdraw consent for marketing communications

To make a request, please contact us at info@eclatbysev.com.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact us at info@eclatbysev.com.

title: Terms & Conditions
desc: The terms that govern use of the Éclat By Sev website and purchases.
intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the Éclat By Sev website and the purchase of products from our store.
inner:

Orders must be paid in full at checkout using the payment methods made available on the website.

6. Shipping

We currently ship within the Netherlands only. Estimated processing and delivery times are provided for guidance and are not guaranteed. Delays may occasionally occur due to circumstances beyond our control.

7. Returns and Refunds

Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unworn items returned in original packaging. Refunds are processed after the returned item has been received and inspected. For more details, please refer to our Shipping & Returns page.

8. Damaged or Incorrect Items

If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, please contact us promptly at info@eclatbysev.com with your order number and supporting photos.

10. Limitation of Liability

11. Governing Law

title: FAQ
desc: Answers to common questions about orders, shipping, returns, care and ring sizes.
intro: A few answers to the questions we receive most often.
inner:
How long does my order take to process?

Most orders are processed within 3–5 business days. During busy periods, processing may take slightly longer.

Where do you ship?

At the moment, Éclat By Sev ships within the Netherlands only.

Do you offer free shipping?

Yes. We offer free standard shipping on all orders over €75 within the Netherlands.

Can I return my order?

Yes. Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery, provided the item is unworn, unused, and returned in its original packaging.

How do I start a return?

Please email us at info@eclatbysev.com with your order number and the reason for your return. We will guide you through the next steps.

What if my item arrives damaged or incorrect?

Please contact us as soon as possible with your order number and photos of the item and packaging. We will review the issue and help resolve it promptly.

How should I care for my jewellery?

To keep your jewellery looking its best, avoid direct contact with perfume, chlorine, water, and harsh chemicals. Store your pieces in their pouch or box and wipe them gently with a soft cloth after wear.

Are your pieces suitable for gifting?

Many of our pieces are designed to feel special enough for gifting. If gift-ready packaging is available for a product, it will be noted on the product page.

How do I choose the right ring size?

Use a ring you already own and measure its inner diameter, or wrap a strip of paper around your finger and compare it with a standard size chart. If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up for a more comfortable fit.

How can I contact you?

You can reach us anytime at info@eclatbysev.com.

title: Our story
desc: The story behind Éclat By Sev, a founder-led jewellery label.
inner:
Éclat By Sev was created for women who want elegance to feel effortless. It is a brand built on the belief that jewellery should not only complete a look, but transform how you feel in it.

After years of working within one of Turkey's leading luxury fashion houses, I learned something simple but important: looking refined should not require spending a fortune — but it should never mean settling for less.

That is why I created Éclat: where Parisian elegance meets the craftsmanship of Istanbul.

We create refined, statement pieces designed to elevate even the simplest outfit — with intention, softness, and lasting presence.

Founded by Sev

Éclat By Sev is a founder-led jewellery label shaped by a feminine, modern, and detail-focused point of view. Every collection begins with the same intention: to create pieces that feel elevated, wearable, and emotionally expressive.

Craftsmanship

Our pieces are developed with a strong focus on quality, balance, and finish. We believe great jewellery should feel special from the moment you put it on — and remain a piece you reach for again and again.

Small-Batch Philosophy

We prefer thoughtful, limited production over excess. By working in smaller runs, we stay closer to the design process, reduce unnecessary waste, and create collections that feel more intentional.

The Meaning of Éclat

The word Éclat means radiance. It reflects exactly how we want every woman to feel when she wears our pieces: confident, luminous, and effortlessly striking.
